meta.prompt_source: 用户提供题面：英语二 Part B 图表作文（某高校学生每月参加志愿服务次数占比：从未参加 35%；1-2 次 45%；3 次及以上 20%）

band.rationale: 对照第五档描述：'很好地完成了试题规定的任务。包含所有内容要点'——图表三组数据（35%/45%/20%）全部准确转述，'describe the chart'与'give your comments'两项要求均完成；'语言自然流畅，语法错误极少'——逐句核查未发现客观语法、拼写或搭配问题；'有效地采用多种衔接手法，文字连贯，层次清晰'——while/On the one hand/In my view/Therefore 衔接自然，描述-归因-评论三段完整；'格式和语域恰当贴切'。与第五档上限的差距在评论深度和词汇丰富度，属档内扣分，不构成降档到第四档的理由。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percent of the students never participate in volunteer work, while 45 percent volunteer one or two times a month, and only 20 percent do so three times or more

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: Through volunteering, students can gain practical skills, broaden their horizons and develop a stronger sense of responsibility.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 评论段是'好处罗列+通用建议'，未回扣图中最有张力的数据（35% 从未参加）；归因段两条理由（学业压力、信息缺乏）停留在概括层面，无进一步展开，论证深度一般。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: Two factors may explain this pattern.

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: some students are willing to help others, but they lack information about how to join suitable programs

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: give priority to their studies and regard volunteer work as a luxury
dimensions.deduction_reason: 搭配准确且有亮点（give priority to / regard...as a luxury / timely information），但 broaden their horizons 等以教科书高频表达为主，volunteer work/activities/volunteering 轮换之外缺少更精准多样的选词，词汇密度对第五档'丰富的词汇'而言略显不足。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: In my view, volunteer activities deserve more attention.

consistency.adjustments: 初评维度分 5+2.5+2+2+1.5+1=14，落在第五档 13-15 区间内，一次通过，无需回退调整。字数引用脚本结果 149（ratio 0.993，soft_ok，未达任何罚分线），不在字数上扣分。

sentence_edits.original: The chart above illustrates how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities each month.
sentence_edits.issue: 'students in a university' 中的介词搭配略生硬，'at a university' 更自然；此处仅为润色参考，不影响得分。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart above illustrates how often students at a university take part in volunteer activities each month.

sentence_edits.original: According to the survey, 35 percent of the students never participate in volunteer work, while 45 percent volunteer one or two times a month, and only 20 percent do so three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: 三个分句用 while...and... 串联，信息密度偏高，拆成两句层次更清楚；另外信息来源与题面保持一致用 the chart 更稳妥。原句本身成立，仅作润色参考。
sentence_edits.revised: According to the chart, 35 percent of the students never participate in volunteer work. Another 45 percent volunteer once or twice a month, while only 20 percent do so three times or more.

sentence_edits.original: On the one hand, many students are under heavy academic pressure, so they give priority to their studies and regard volunteer work as a luxury.
sentence_edits.issue: 'On the one hand / On the other hand' 习惯上引出对立的两面，而这里两条原因（没时间、缺信息）是并列关系，用 'For one thing / For another' 更贴切。语法本身没有问题，不直接扣分。
sentence_edits.revised: For one thing, many students are under heavy academic pressure, so they give priority to their studies and regard volunteer work as a luxury.

sentence_edits.original: Through volunteering, students can gain practical skills, broaden their horizons and develop a stronger sense of responsibility.
sentence_edits.issue: 'broaden their horizons' 是教科书高频表达，换成更贴合志愿话题的说法会更有个人色彩；仅作表达升级参考，不影响得分。
sentence_edits.revised: Through volunteering, students can gain practical skills, get a better understanding of society and develop a stronger sense of responsibility.

improved_version:
The chart above illustrates how often students at a university take part in volunteer activities each month. According to the figures, 35 percent of the students never participate in volunteer work, 45 percent volunteer once or twice a month, and only 20 percent do so three times or more. Clearly, volunteering is part of college life for most students, but a large group remains uninvolved.

Two factors may explain this pattern. For one thing, many students are under heavy academic pressure, so they give priority to their studies and regard volunteer work as a luxury. For another, some students are willing to help but lack information about how to join suitable programs.

In my view, volunteer activities deserve more attention, especially given that one third of the students never take part. Through volunteering, students can gain practical skills and develop a stronger sense of responsibility. Therefore, the university should provide more opportunities and timely information, and students should learn to balance study with service to society.
top_problems: 评论段模板化、未回扣数据：好处罗列和两条建议对任何志愿类题目都通用，没有利用图中最突出的 35%'从未参加'做针对性评论，这是内容展开维度失分的主因。
词汇安全有余、亮点不足：除 give priority to / regard...as a luxury 外，多为 broaden their horizons 一类教科书搭配，对照第五档'使用丰富的语法结构和词汇'的要求显得密度偏低。
衔接词逻辑精度：On the one hand / On the other hand 惯用于对立两面，此处两条并列原因用 For one thing / For another 更准确（判为 awkward，未直接扣分，但同方向问题再密集就会影响词汇/语法维度）。
practice_advice: 做'数据回扣'专项训练：写完图表描述段后，从图中挑出最反常或最突出的一组数据（本题是 35% 从未参加），用 'What the chart reveals is that...' 或 'especially given that...' 造一句接进评论段开头。每周用 3 道不同图表题重复这个动作，评论的针对性会明显提升。

patterns: The chart above illustrates how often + 主语 + 行为（图表主题句骨架）
X percent ..., while Y percent ..., and only Z percent ...（三组占比一句呈现）
Two factors may explain this pattern.（归因段总起句）
Therefore, A should ..., and B should learn to balance X with Y.（双主体建议收尾句）
words: take part in / participate in / volunteering（同义轮换避免重复）
regard volunteer work as a luxury
develop a stronger sense of responsibility
balance study with service to society
